item.title: Rheem Reveals Sustainability Goals for 2035
item.description: Rheem is raising the bar on sustainability with a new commitment to train more than a million HVAC contractors and industry professionals worldwide over the next decade.

item.title: LG Helps Modernize America’s Homes Through Comprehensive Unitary HVAC Solutions
item.description: LG’s portfolio presents a new generation of cooling and heating solutions, giving HVAC professionals additional product options and offering homeowners options that may support energy efficiency and comfort suitable for varied home layouts and regional climates across the U.S.

item.title: Conference for Field Service Pros Scheduled for Nashville
item.description: SEC26 brings together the owners and leaders of service businesses from across North America for two days of connection focused on helping the businesses grow and adapt in today’s market.

item.title: AHRI Standards Updates Aim to Clarify Performance, Flexibility, and Emissions for Contractors and Homeowners
item.description: New seasonal efficiency metrics aim to replace single-point testing with ratings that actually reflect how systems run in homes.

item.title: Heatcraft Unveils CO2, A2L Refrigeration Options
item.description: Heatcraft highlighted new refrigeration products, as well as robust training opportunities to help contractors and end users through the refrigerant transition.

item.title: GF Uponor Expands Portfolio, Targets Commercial Growth
item.description: At the 2026 AHR Expo, executives highlighted CPVC and prefabricated PEX solutions, double-digit growth in key segments, and plans to drive innovation in emerging markets such as data centers and life sciences.

item.title: NAVAC Introduces Smartphone-Style Manifolds to Speed HVAC Diagnostics
item.description: During the 2026 AHR Expo, NAVAC pushed HVAC tool innovation forward with 18 new product launches, including digital manifold gauges that adopt smartphone-style touchscreen technology to make diagnostics faster and intuitive.

item.title: LG: Not Just a Mini-Split Manufacturer Anymore
item.description: LG is no longer positioning itself as a brand focused on add-on rooms and ductless applications. Instead, the company is emphasizing its ability to serve an entire home or building.

item.title: WaterFurnace Highlights Resiliency, Affordability
item.description: WaterFurnace focused on accelerating geothermal adoption by emphasizing grid resiliency and affordability.

item.title: JCI Targets Data Center Boom with Scalable Cooling
item.description: With more than 100 gigawatts of U.S. data center demand coming online and a trillion-dollar market looming, Johnson Controls is investing in high-capacity chillers, water-free cooling strategies, and global consistency.
